children: Turtlemint shares rose up to 7 percent on Thursday after domestic brokerage Motilal Oswal initiated coverage on the stock with a buy rating and set a target price of Rs 180, implying an upside potential of nearly 41 percent.

The stock hit an intraday high of Rs 136.59 per share on the NSE, gaining 7 percent. Later, some profit booking emerged at higher levels and the stock was trading at Rs 131.40 per share, up 2.87 percent.
The uptick came after Motilal Oswal said in its latest research report that the stock was trading at an attractive valuation.

"Turtlemint currently trades at 17x Sep'28E EV/EBITDA, which appears attractive given the earnings compounding ahead. We initiate coverage on the stock with a BUY rating and a TP of INR180 premised on Sep'28E EV/EBITDA of 20x," the brokerage said.
It added that the key risk was regulatory uncertainty around commission structures, partly offset by passing the impact through to distribution partners.
The target price of Rs 180 is nearly 41 percent higher than the stock's closing price on Wednesday.
Motilal Oswal said there was headroom for indirect cost efficiency, with direct costs largely linked to partner payouts and corporate overheads offering the principal margin opportunity.
"With the growth algorithm shifting from recruitment to activation and productivity, the operating leverage is at an inflection point," it said.
The brokerage expects corporate overheads to clock a 6 percent CAGR over FY26-29, resulting in adjusted EBITDA breakeven in FY27 and margin expansion of around 11 percent by FY29.
On the company's technology-led PoSP franchise, Motilal Oswal said Turtlemint Fintech Solutions has built a scaled, technology-enabled insurance distribution franchise in India.

It said the company has more than 5.5 lakh certified Point-of-Sale Persons (PoSPs) and a strong foothold in India's insurance distribution, with more than 75 percent of premiums originating from B30+ markets.
Turtlemint Fintech shares made its market debut in June this year.

Shares of Turtlemint Fintech Solutions were listed at Rs 134.90 per share on the NSE, a discount listing of 11.25 percent. The Rs 883-crore initial public offering (IPO) had a price band of Rs 144-152 per share.
The company focuses on simplifying the purchase and management of insurance policies and has sold around 1.6 crore policies through a network of more than five lakh advisors.
